mixed standalone CHARGE/MOVE second-pass PDP omission

p16_3_1_final_acceptance.all_outbound_blocked: skip TARGET_NODE_NOT_APPLIED and retain inventory partial result

p16_3_3_final_acceptance.candidate_filter: active and safely reachable chargers only
p16_3_3_final_acceptance.selection: lowest configured cost among safe candidates
p16_3_3_final_acceptance.fallback: closest safe candidate when safe candidates have no cost data

p16_5_2_final_acceptance.required_task_policy: reject dropped tasks or missing task assignments during response postprocessing

p16_5_3_final_acceptance.cuopt_service_time_policy: PICK/DROP use one local time step

p16_5_4_final_acceptance.complex_clause_direction: A/B OUTBOUND, C/D INBOUND, E/F OUTBOUND, final C INBOUND

p16_5_4_final_acceptance.blocked_shortage_visibility: INVENTORY_PROJECTION evidence retained even when task omitted before optimization

p16_5_6_final_acceptance.fixed_error: ROUTE_FAILED on second simultaneous inbound DROP to shared STORAGE 2088
p16_5_6_final_acceptance.idle_service_node_policy: Relocate between-task long idle from STORAGE/INBOUND/OUTBOUND/CHARGER/DESTINATION to non-service holding node
p16_5_6_final_acceptance.holding_node_safety: Exclude congestion nodes and articulation/cut vertices such as gateway 2044
p16_5_6_final_acceptance.shared_initial_node_policy: Sparse first routes from the same snapshot node activate on successive free time steps

p16_5_7_final_acceptance.fixed_behavior: Long idle on ROUTE/INTERSECTION/SERVICE/CHARGER nodes is no longer accepted for daily plans
p16_5_7_final_acceptance.initial_idle_policy: Robots with far-future first tasks relocate from snapshot service/charger nodes to designated idle bays

p16_5_8_final_acceptance.business_schedule_policy: Opportunity CHARGE tasks fit inside existing idle gaps and do not delay original work tasks
p16_5_8_final_acceptance.charger_slot_policy: CHARGER slot is occupied only during CHARGE; robot leaves to linked CHARGER_WAITING_AREA after completion

p16_5_8_1_final_acceptance.replan_charge_policy: Remove stale opportunity:* tasks and regenerate from current business schedule
p16_5_8_1_final_acceptance.route_prefix_policy: Duplicate endpoint removal may leave zero appended waypoints without indexing an empty list
p16_5_8_1_final_acceptance.failure_evidence_policy: Preserve previous_successful_candidate when a later verification or replan fails

p16_5_9_final_acceptance.frozen_policy: Do not shift; block the candidate when capacity conflicts
p16_5_9_final_acceptance.hard_window_policy: Block candidates whose resource delay exceeds latest_finish

p16_5_10_2_route_order_convergence.shared_resource_order: same dependency-aware per-robot order as routing
p16_5_10_2_route_order_convergence.live_regression: later CHARGE priority must not precede earlier PICK/DROP dependency chain

p16_5_11_mapf_auto_replan.local_scope_policy: Change affected robot tasks only; freeze unaffected tasks and protected freeze-horizon work
p16_5_11_mapf_auto_replan.escalation_policy: One controlled LOCAL to GLOBAL escalation for identical retryable MAPF signature
p16_5_11_mapf_auto_replan.terminal_guard: Normal repeated-signature and max-replan-attempt guards remain after escalation

p16_5_11_1_event_escalation_hotfix.observed_failure: Second identical PATH_BLOCKED event was stopped by REPEATED_FAILURE_DETECTED before global escalation.
p16_5_11_1_event_escalation_hotfix.root_cause: EventReplanService repeat-signature guard executed before the P16.5.11 planning-level MAPF escalation policy.

p16_5_12_runtime_robot_state_partial_rep.low_battery_policy: Moderate battery preserves current execution; critical battery or safe-stop confirmation releases affected unfinished work.

p16_5_12_1_runtime_source_plan_hotfix.observed_failure: LOW_BATTERY impact analysis succeeded, but generated planning command ended FAILED with no plan version, simulation id, verification decision, or diagnostic error.
root_causes: Snapshot validation treated event source-plan robot/task identifiers as missing because they were not persisted SQL entities.
Inventory precheck compared runtime task ids directly with SQL work ids and classified them as unknown.
Task selection reconstructed only SQL works and did not materialize source_plan_snapshot.required_tasks.
p16_5_12_1_runtime_source_plan_hotfix.policy: EVENT_SOURCE_PLAN is an authoritative planning contract for runtime temporary tasks while SQL remains authoritative for persisted works.
changes: Resolve runtime task ids to their source-plan work ids during Snapshot and inventory validation.
Include source-plan robot assignments and node references in Snapshot validation.
Materialize source required_tasks and derive missing candidates/robot bindings from scheduled_tasks.
Expose planner status/final status and a deterministic AUTO_REPLAN_PLANNING_FAILED error when verification is missing.

root_causes: Absolute schedule date prefixes were outside the time-window grammar.
Undated follow-up windows did not inherit the preceding explicit date.
Explicit send-charge-perform robot workflow was not recognized as a fixed assignment.

scope: bounded CPU fallback for invalid charge second pass

p16_5_13_gate1_3_relocation_window_fallb.scope: historical inventory availability is not a MOVE_TO_NEXT hard latest-finish

routing failure hid simulation battery metrics and caused a false override failure
far-future routes without explicit activation metadata materialized dense pre-start waits

policies.optimizer_target: auditable target, not a hard deadline
policies.resource_delay: shift the assigned robot downstream chain
policies.battery_override_verification: optimization input authoritative; simulation metric checked when present
policies.future_activation: sparse by default unless strict idle-whitelist or explicit override requires holding

p16_5_13_gate2_server_authority.redis_missing_recovery: PostgreSQL simulation session, then latest simulation run

p16_5_13_gate2_1_low_battery_safety_char.root_cause: server-derived LOW_BATTERY correctly detected remaining mission risk, but the currently executing affected task remained frozen, preventing CHARGE insertion before that task

policies.freeze_exception: release only affected tasks when server-derived remaining-plan threshold is crossed
policies.robot_binding: keep the affected pickup/drop chain on the reporting robot while battery remains above the hard minimum
policies.emergency_threshold: battery at or below the hard minimum remains eligible for stop/reassignment policy
policies.recovery_order: current position -> safe charger -> CHARGE -> PICK -> DROP

p16_5_13_gate2_2_changeable_cuopt_freeze.root_cause: managed cuOpt assignment postprocessing treated assigned_robot_id as a timing freeze even when the affected LOCAL_REPLAN tasks were explicitly changeable

policies.changeable_robot_binding: LOCAL_REPLAN changeable tasks retain assigned_robot_id but remain frozen=false
policies.fixed_scope_precedence: fixed_task_ids continue to win over malformed fixed/changeable overlap
policies.recovery_order: current position -> safe charger -> CHARGE -> PICK -> DROP

root_causes: an already-opened successor earliest_start became an impossible CHARGE latest_finish during the explicit second pass
failed automatic replans did not expose enough optimizer and route-energy evidence to distinguish charge creation from charge loss

policies.opened_window: historical/opened earliest_start is never promoted to a new CHARGE deadline
policies.future_window: only a successor start later than the first-pass charge target end may constrain CHARGE completion
policies.charge_retention: one deterministic local safety recovery when low-battery business work remains but CHARGE is absent
policies.failure_debug: bounded charge/two-pass/assignment/energy evidence is returned on failed event replans
policies.recovery_order: current position -> safe charger -> CHARGE -> MOVE_TO_NEXT -> PICK -> DROP

policies.event_identity: same event_id requires the same operational payload
policies.simulation_rollback: restore pre-event Redis snapshot on durable checkpoint failure
policies.plan_retention: failed automatic replan restores the last verified simulation plan
policies.recovery_replay: retryable stored failures resume through idempotent reconciliation

policies.pre_pick_failure: exclude failed robot and reassign original unfinished chain
policies.secured_load_failure: replace original PICK/DROP with server-generated handover PICK/DROP at failed stop node
policies.handover_binding: both recovery tasks must use the same non-failed replacement robot
policies.manual_guard: unknown load, missing stop node, unsafe stop, or unsecured load returns MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED
policies.candidate_filter: exclude failed/offline/maintenance robots and enforce residual load capacity when known
policies.inventory_semantics: handover PICK uses source_type ROBOT_HANDOVER and does not replay storage inventory pickup

policies.changed_set: cuOpt changed ∪ event affected ∪ failed/excluded robots
policies.route_eviction: failed/excluded robots contribute no preserved active route or reservation
policies.handover_state: failed stop remains represented by runtime override and synthetic handover tasks
policies.observability: collision metadata and event response expose stale_route_eviction evidence

policies.plan_approval: only PASS/PASS_WITH_WARNING plans are approved with immutable operational fingerprints
policies.active_plan_authority: dispatch requires exact Redis active plan version and fingerprint match
policies.dispatch_idempotency: deterministic dispatch_id and idempotency_key prevent duplicate robot execution
policies.ack_sequence: per-robot ACKs must follow strict next-command sequence; duplicate identical ACKs are idempotent
policies.retry: transport attempts are durably counted and retries reuse the same dispatch identity
policies.failure_cancel: unfinished commands are canceled after command failure or operator cancel
policies.rollback: logical active-plan rollback occurs only before physical progress; otherwise manual recovery is required

policies.legacy_sql_work: <work_id>:move is valid outbound target evidence only for an explicitly linked outbound operation
policies.target_match: MOVE target_node must equal a user-requested destination
policies.positive_feasibility: linked outbound work must have planned_quantity_boxes > 0 when feasibility evidence is present
policies.identity_guard: task_id must be exactly the canonical <work_id>:move identity
policies.relocation_guard: unrelated relocation/parking MOVE rows do not satisfy outbound destination constraints
policies.operation_namespace: operation_id work:<work_id> is normalized only for explicit SQL-work binding

policies.confirmation_gate: logical active-plan rollback requires explicit gateway accepted=true and canceled status
policies.unconfirmed_cancel: 404, timeout, transport error, unsupported, or rejected response keeps the new plan active
policies.conservative_state: unconfirmed cancellation uses CANCELED_PARTIAL_EXECUTION, CANCEL_PENDING commands, manual recovery, and retryable=true
policies.recovery_replay: repeating cancel after gateway recovery confirms cancellation and only then restores the previous active plan
policies.physical_progress: ACKed MOVE/PICKUP/DROPOFF/CHARGE prevents logical rollback even after gateway cancellation
policies.ack_after_cancel: ACKs received while cancellation is unconfirmed preserve the recovery-required dispatch state and update physical progress evidence
policies.command_failure: automatic cancellation after command failure follows the same gateway-confirmation gate before rollback
policies.gateway_identity: cancel uses the remote gateway dispatch_id stored or deterministically precomputed at durable dispatch creation, not the service database dispatch_id
policies.timeout_identity: precomputed gateway identity remains available when dispatch response times out after possible gateway acceptance

live_findings: ACK occurred_at could predate durable command sent_at
RETRY_EXHAUSTED dispatch retained PENDING command states
safe rollback required manual ACTIVE_PLAN reservation release
retry exhaustion rollback evidence was visible only in exception text

policies.ack_lifecycle: ACK accepted only for AWAITING_ACK/PARTIAL_ACK or gateway-cancel-unconfirmed recovery window
policies.ack_time: occurred_at older than sent_at minus 5 seconds is rejected
policies.terminal_commands: retry-exhausted unfinished commands become DISPATCH_FAILED with DISPATCH_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
policies.rollback_persistence: retry-exhaustion rollback is stored in result_summary.rollback
policies.reservation_cleanup: successful pre-physical rollback releases RESERVED ACTIVE_PLAN reservations
policies.physical_progress_guard: manual-recovery and unconfirmed-cancel paths do not release reservations automatically
